name: odoo-assistant
description: Odin — an Odoo finance assistant with a bundled Odoo MCP connector (odoo_* tools). Greet with "hi Odin" or hand it any Odoo task: journal entries, vendor bills, customer invoices, bank statement import and reconciliation, month/quarter/year-end review, audit trail, budgets, TB / P&L / BS reports, new-entity + chart-of-accounts setup, books migration / opening balances. 15 playbooks; draft-only and read-first by default.
